cases.name: TestExtractMetricValue_CPU
cases.description: CPU metric value is correctly extracted from snapshot

cases.name: TestExtractMetricValue_RAM
cases.description: RAM metric value is correctly extracted from snapshot

cases.name: Alert fires when threshold exceeded
cases.description: Alert engine creates an alert record when a metric crosses its configured threshold
cases.then: Alert is created and persisted in SQLite

cases.name: Alert respects cooldown window
cases.description: Repeated threshold violations within cooldown period do not create duplicate alerts
cases.given: Alert rule with 15-min cooldown; alert already fired within window

cases.name: TestBruteForce_AllowsUnderLimit
cases.description: IP is not locked before reaching MaxAttempts failures

cases.name: TestBruteForce_LocksAtLimit
cases.description: IP is locked after reaching MaxAttempts failures
cases.given: Exactly MaxAttempts failed login attempts from 192.168.1.1

cases.name: TestBruteForce_DifferentIPsIndependent
cases.description: Brute-force counters are tracked independently per IP
cases.given: MaxAttempts failures from 192.168.1.1; zero failures from 192.168.1.2
cases.when: IsLocked is checked for both IPs

cases.name: Valid CSRF token passes validation
cases.description: A token generated by the CSRF manager is accepted on validation

cases.name: Invalid CSRF token is rejected
cases.description: A forged or missing token is rejected

cases.name: Ring buffer retains last N samples
cases.description: After filling past capacity, oldest samples are overwritten
cases.given: Ring buffer of size N; N+5 values pushed
cases.then: Only the last N values are returned in insertion order

cases.name: Ring buffer is empty on creation
cases.description: A newly created ring buffer returns no samples

cases.name: Collector produces valid snapshot
cases.description: After a collection cycle, the snapshot contains non-zero CPU and RAM readings

cases.name: Monitor returns container list
cases.description: Monitor.Containers() returns a slice of ContainerInfo
cases.given: Docker socket available with at least one container
cases.then: Returns non-empty slice of ContainerInfo with Name, State, Image populated

cases.name: Monitor handles Docker unavailable gracefully
cases.description: When Docker socket is not available, monitor returns empty list without panicking
cases.given: Docker socket path does not exist
cases.then: Returns empty slice and error is logged; no panic

cases.name: Monitor returns service list
cases.description: Monitor.Services() returns a slice of ServiceInfo
cases.then: Returns slice of ServiceInfo with Name and State populated

cases.name: Dispatcher routes to Telegram when configured
cases.description: Alert with severity >= warning is delivered to Telegram notifier
cases.given: Telegram notifier configured with valid token/chat ID
cases.when: Dispatch is called with a warning alert
cases.then: Telegram notifier Send() is called with the alert payload

cases.name: Dispatcher skips unconfigured channels
cases.description: No error when a channel is not configured
cases.then: Returns no error; email notifier is not invoked

cases.name: CreateUser and GetUserByUsername roundtrip
cases.description: A user created in the DB can be retrieved by username
cases.given: New SQLite DB; CreateUser called with 'admin' and bcrypt hash
cases.then: Returns user with matching username and hashed password

cases.name: CreateSession and ValidateSession roundtrip
cases.description: A session token stored in the DB is valid on retrieval
cases.when: ValidateSession is called with the token
cases.then: Returns the user ID associated with the session

cases.name: CreateAlert and ListAlerts roundtrip
cases.description: An alert saved to the DB appears in the list
cases.then: Returns slice containing the newly created alert

cases.name: Unauthenticated request is redirected to login
cases.description: All protected routes redirect to /login when no valid session cookie is present

cases.name: POST with invalid CSRF token returns 403
cases.description: State-changing requests without valid CSRF token are rejected
cases.given: Valid session cookie; missing or invalid CSRF token

cases.name: SSE endpoint keeps connection open
cases.description: The /events endpoint responds with Content-Type: text/event-stream and does not close immediately
cases.then: Response header Content-Type is text/event-stream; connection stays open

cases.name: Status returns empty peers when Tailscale unavailable
cases.description: When Tailscale CLI is not installed, status returns empty peer list without error
cases.then: Returns Status with empty Peers slice; no panic

cases.name: Config loads from environment variables
cases.description: All config fields are populated from env vars

cases.name: Config uses defaults when env vars absent
cases.description: Default values are applied when env vars are not set

cases.name: TestServiceStart_Success
cases.description: Service start action succeeds and returns 200 with HTMX partial
cases.given: Authenticated session with valid CSRF token
cases.then: Returns 200; action is persisted in history

cases.name: TestDockerStart_Success
cases.description: Docker container start action succeeds
cases.given: Authenticated session with valid CSRF token

cases.name: TestServiceStart_RequiresCSRF
cases.description: Service control endpoints enforce CSRF

cases.name: TestDashboard_Returns200
cases.description: Dashboard page renders successfully for authenticated users

cases.name: TestDashboard_ContainsSidebar
cases.description: Dashboard includes navigation sidebar

cases.name: TestDashboard_ContainsCSRFToken
cases.description: Dashboard embeds CSRF token in rendered HTML

test_cases.area: Server — Action History and Log Viewer

cases.name: TestHistoryPage_RendersLogs
cases.description: History page renders action log entries
cases.given: Authenticated session; existing action history entries
cases.then: Returns 200 with action log entries in response

cases.name: TestHistoryPage_FilterByDocker
cases.description: History page can filter by docker source
cases.given: Authenticated session; docker action entries present

cases.name: TestMiddleware_RootRedirectsToLoginWithoutSession
cases.description: Unauthenticated requests to protected routes are blocked at middleware layer
cases.then: Redirects to /login; no privileged operation is reached

cases.name: TestLogin_SetsSecureCookie_WhenForwardedProtoHTTPS
cases.description: Session cookie is set with Secure flag when behind HTTPS proxy

cases.name: TestSettings_RendersPage
cases.description: Settings page renders including hardware configuration section
cases.then: Returns 200 with settings page including hardware config

cases.name: TestBackupConfigSave_PersistsAndApplies
cases.description: Backup configuration is persisted and applied when saved
cases.given: Authenticated session; valid CSRF token; backup config payload
cases.then: Config is saved; backup schedule is applied

cases.name: TestRecordBackupOutcome_LogsAction
cases.description: Backup outcome is recorded in the action history
cases.then: Action log entry is created with correct status
